title: BUGFIX — produce-vlog: add macOS say fallback inside generateTTSBackbone()
rationale: After Sprint 1334 (HeyGen→ElevenLabs fallback), the educational pipeline still fails completely when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is also missing or ElevenLabs is down — because generateTTSBackbone() throws 'ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set'. Fix: add macOS `say` TTS as a third-level fallback inside generateTTSBackbone(). When ElevenLabs is unavailable, use `say -v Samantha -r 175 -o /tmp/tts.aiff '<text>'` + ffmpeg AIFF→mp3 conversion, then combine with the same dark background video. Cost: $0.00. This makes the educational pipeline fully offline-capable: HeyGen → ElevenLabs → macOS say → video always ships.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/produce-vlog.ts generateTTSBackbone(): (1) Remove the hard throw when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is missing. (2) Wrap the ElevenLabs fetch block in try/catch. (3) In the catch (or when key missing): log '[produce-vlog] ElevenLabs unavailable — using macOS say TTS', then: sanitize monologue (replace double-quotes), run `say -v Samantha -r 175 -o /tmp/tts_audio.aiff '<sanitized>'`, convert with ffmpeg AIFF→mp3, get duration. (4) Continue with the existing dark background video generation (step 3) using the local mp3.
